title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v107
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add adaptive batching reporting pipeline (v107) for benchmark-lab. Motivation: we need richer telemetry for adaptive-batching experiments (latency P95/P99 under mixed workloads, batching utilization, cache hit rates) and a stable nightly reporting pipeline that produces variant-aware dashboards and CSV exports for downstream analysis. This PR introduces a new Airflow DAG, representative workload runners that exercise adaptive batching profiles, profiling baseline collectors, unit and integration tests, and documentation updates. Checklist: - [x] implement airflow DAG and reporting tasks - [x] add representative runners for multi-variant adaptive batching - [x] emit telemetry with versioned schema v2 - [x] add unit/integration tests and CI job - [x] update docs and runbooks - [x] manual end-to-end validation against staging benchmark lab Context and related work: builds on previous adaptive-batching work (see ENG-2643, pr-324790) and ties to the profiling baselines added in v73-v86. This PR also surfaces metrics needed by the Autoscaler team for policy tuning (ENG-3045).
commits: Initial scaffolding: add airflow DAG and task skeletons
Add representative runners: mixed_workload_runner and multi_variant_runner with config-driven profiles
Emit telemetry: add reporting shim and v2 CSV schema for adaptive batching
Add profiling baselines collector and aggregator
Add unit tests for runners and DAG, integration test for end-to-end reporting
Docs: add benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching README and runbook
Fix: address flaky test by increasing runner timeouts and adding isolation in test harness

benchmark-lab/runners/representative/multi_variant_runner.py - new runner exercising multi-variant inputs and sequence-length distributions
benchmark-lab/runners/representative/mixed_workload_runner.py - runner to simulate client-mix traffic for autoscaler signals
benchmark-lab/profiling/collectors/baseline_collector.py - collects memory/latency baselines and serializes to v2 schema
infra/airflow/operators/reporting_tasks.py - lightweight operators for upload and aggregation
docs/benchmarks/adaptive-batching.md - new runbook and example dashboard queries
tests/benchmark_lab/test_reporting_pipeline.py - integration test that runs DAG against local sqlite and asserts CSV schema
ci/workflows/benchmark-lab-report.yml - add nightly workflow to exercise the pipeline in staging

release_notes: Adds adaptive batching reporting pipeline (v107) with representative workload runners and profiling baseline collection. Outputs versioned CSV (v2) compatible with existing dashboards. Enables better autoscaler signal generation and nightly reporting.
